steps.en: Officer endorses a decision on a work item
steps.id: Officer meng-endorse keputusan lewat work item
steps.why_en: Only a screen exists; the endorse services are missing and the menu is off.
steps.why_id: Hanya layar yang ada; layanan endorse tidak ada dan menu dimatikan.

steps.why_en: No storage for endorsements exists in the backend.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan endorsement tidak ada di backend.

steps.en: A monthly endorsement report is generated
steps.why_en: The monthly job exists but only for payment and HST reports.
steps.why_id: Job bulanan ada tapi hanya untuk laporan pembayaran dan HST.

steps.en: The officer opens the report on screen
steps.why_en: No endorsement report appears on the dashboard or in the report area.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada laporan endorsement di dashboard maupun area laporan.

steps.why_en: There is no endorsement report file to download.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada file laporan endorsement untuk diunduh.
